title: Kiichi's Aggression (1254)
problem: The splash is 50% of the Bleed amount worked out at the start of turn (bc_CalculateBleedDamage plus the start-of-turn Bleed modifiers), before the damage pipeline. Then each splash hit runs through the pipeline with no source (dtype indirect). That matches the claim. The text says "50% of that damage".
notes: Community claim: The splash is 50% of the base Bleed amount, not of the damage dealt; boosted by general "takes more damage", not by Bleed-only boosts (except the Pilwiz card). Evidence: bc_CreatureStartOfTurn: Bleed amount from bc_CalculateBleedDamage @0x140b6f1ee into [rsp+0x1b2d0]; gate @0x140b75a82 / 0x140b75c57; bc_GetAlliesOf(c, false, false) @0x140b75eaa; × 0.5 of [rsp+0x1b2d0] @0x140b763de; source −1. Fix sketch: Reword to "50% of its Bleeding damage" (T). Triage 2026-10-26: Ruling 2026-10-26 (stat/scope/trigger wording): text matches code. The splash is 50% of the base Bleed amount. 2026-10-26: text correction shipped via localization_override (loader text module). | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "all other enemies take 50% of that damage". Fix: H: base the splash on the damage the Bleed tick actually dealt (after the pipeline) instead of the pre-pipeline Bleed amount (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn @0x140b763de). vs bugged: depends. | Left needs-hook (batch C): the splash is computed in bc_CreatureStartOfTurn before the Bleed tick goes through the damage pipeline (the tick is queued as an event and resolved later), so the dealt amount does not exist yet. A fix must move the splash into the damage event of the Bleed tick. Round-2 C2 2026-10-26: still needs-hook. Two blockers: the splash events are queued with the pre-pipeline Bleed amount before the tick resolves, and 'take 50% of that damage' runs into the same no-modifier-free-path issue as SU-0140 (the splash hits go through the pipeline again). Wants the SU-0140 decision first; then: record the tick's dealt amount in bc_ExecuteEvents' damage case and resize the already-queued splash events. User ruling 2026-10-26 (with SU-0140): Splashing-style splash of the damage actually dealt. Batch C3: the Bleed tick's bc_EventDamage call (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn @0x140b7042e) is hooked to remember the amount the built event will deal; the Kiichi's Aggression splash calls (@0x140b767bd, built later in the same start of turn) use 50% of it; if the tick was prevented (builder returned -1) no splash is queued. The splash stays sourceless and indirect, like the Bleed tick itself (Bleed has no source, so there is no kill credit to keep). In-game test: an enemy with Bleeding and damage reduction (e.g. Defending): the other enemies take half of what the Bleed tick actually dealt, not half of the full Bleed amount; a fully prevented tick causes no splash.

release_notes.intended: After an enemy takes Bleed damage, all other enemies take 50% of that damage.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the splash used the Bleed amount before the enemy's damage reductions.
release_notes.fix: Now the splash is 50% of the damage the enemy actually took; a fully prevented tick causes no splash.
